changes: SourcePolicy validates scheme, allowed root, traversal and depth before Provider access
SourceDeclarationParser extracts only root and system Source declarations with secure JDK StAX
DTD, external entities and external resource resolution are disabled
MixSourceResolver resolves root, file sets, system, rules and business without producing T04 Canonical data
SourceManifest sorts by sourceId, rejects duplicate identity and freezes total bytes
MixSourceGraph freezes exact declaration edges and immutable SourceManifest
Provider null, exception and typed-result contract violations map to stable policy diagnostics
duplicate sourceId maps to MIX_SOURCE_DUPLICATE_ID before generic typed-result validation
depth, source count and total byte limits fail without publishing a partial graph
main and test mix mirrors are mounted only as Compiler test resources

fixed_graph.provider_call_oracle_correction: The original test expected 10 calls, but one file-set call can return multiple Sources. Correct calls are root, two file sets, system, three rules and business.
